originalTitle: MEET THE VILLAINS - Calling All Villains
content: The FINAL TRAILER drops Oct 24th. The #CallingAllVillains Pilot drops OCTOBER 31st. ___________________________ Calling All Villains is a 3D animated sci-fi/action/comedy series produced and creatively helmed by ZAMination, starring Mr. Puzzles--originally from SMG4. This isn’t a direct continuation of SMG4. Set years later, the series follows Mr. Puzzles as he’s evolved--for better or worse... roping him into all-new adventures with a brand new cast of characters. Haven't seen SMG4? No problem! Calling All Villains is built as a fresh starting point, so you can jump right in and enjoy the ride. And for longtime fans, there are plenty of hidden nods and juicy Easter eggs waiting for you... ___________________________ 🔊 JOIN OUR DISCORD! ▶ https://discord.gg/zamination - Follow us on social media! ▶ https://linktr.ee/zamination ___________________________
